column2: The party cleaved a path across the $$悪魔の海峡$$
and broke the $$封印$$s on the $$冥界の門$$ and $$天国の門$$.
At last, bound for $$ディアボロス$$, the $$約束の地$$,
they entered the interior of the $$バベルの塔$$.
But what they found there was
the soul-rending groans of countless thousands,
and the suspicious looks their companions turned on $$ヨハネ$$.
Would that first tiny stone, once cast,
become a wedge that spread vast ripples across the water...
then swell into a torrent and pour out to sea?
